meta.title: Fexiva - Finance Webflow Template
meta.description: Modern finance/fintech template with green accent theme, mobile app mockups, clean professional UI for expense tracking, payments, business finance.

color.name: accent
color.value: Bright teal/cyan for highlights, balances, icons

typography.headings: Large bold white headings, e.g. "Finance Built For Modern Businesses."

effects.gradients: Strong green radial/linear gradient on hero
effects.mockups: High-fidelity smartphone UI mockups showing app screens (balance, cards, transactions, quick actions)

section.name: Navigation
section.description: Centered or top: Logo (Fexiva with lightning bolt icon) in dark pill, menu links (Home, About, Features, Pricing, Blog), right "Get started" pill button with green accent.

section.name: Hero
section.description: Green gradient bg. Left: Large white heading "Finance Built For Modern Businesses.", subtext about managing expenses, "Get started" button, avatar group "OK Satisfied Users". Center/right: Hand holding smartphone showing detailed finance app UI (balance $24,650.00, cards, transactions list, quick actions icons, overview cards). Floating UI cards on sides for total balance, actions.
section.key_visual: Realistic phone mockup with dark UI, green accents on positive numbers, icons.

section.name: Features / Benefits
section.description: Sections showcasing app features: expense tracking, cards management, analytics, transfers etc. with icons, screenshots, descriptions. Card-based or split layouts.

section.name: Additional
section.description: Pricing, testimonials, blog, CTA sections, consistent green accents on dark.

design_audit.recreation_notes: - Dominant green/teal gradient hero. - High quality mobile app mockups as central visual. - Dark theme with glassmorphism cards. - Clean, modern fintech aesthetic focused on clarity and trust. - Extract exact greens and fonts from live DevTools for pixel match.
